title: Check num partitions on a dataframe in spark connect
question:
In normal pyspark, I can check the number of partitions on a dataframe using the rdd api. In spark connect, that api isn't available. Is there another way people have found to check the number of partitions on a spark connect dataframe?

I've tried the normal df.rdd.getNumPartitions() and got an error about the attribute being unsupported in connect
answer:
In Spark Connect DataFrame: use the spark_partition_id() function.

from pyspark.sql.functions import spark_partition_id, countDistinct

df.withColumn("partition_id", spark_partition_id()) \
  .groupBy("partition_id") \
  .count() \
  .show()
